articles.title: Coldcard ships firmware after $114 million bitcoin theft; says AI helped catch more bugs
articles.snippet: Three weeks of review turned up problems unrelated to the flaw that cost users $114 million, but updating still does not make a compromised wallet safe.

articles.title: Strategy Bitcoin treasury hits breakeven point as BTC price passes $77K
articles.snippet: Bitcoin gains 20% in two days as Strategy sees its BTC treasury climb out of the red.

articles.title: South Korean lawmakers seek expanded FIU powers over unregistered crypto firms
articles.snippet: The proposal would let the FIU investigate suspected violations and refer unregistered crypto operators directly to law enforcement.

articles.title: Binance opens crypto trading to AI agents with user-set controls
articles.snippet: Binance’s Agent OS lets AI agents access market data, execute trades and make payments while giving users control over permissions and account access.

articles.title: MiCA cracks down on USDT in Europe... but no one else cares
articles.snippet: USDT is disappearing from regulated European platforms, but there is little sign that it has resulted in weakening global demand for Tether.
